observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains steps clearly with a count-in and breaks down movements for both solo and partnered practice. They alternate between instructing and demonstrating while maintaining an encouraging tone throughout the tutorial.

lesson_structure.note: Instructors introduce the series on Quebradita and the basic step.
Female instructor demonstrates solo basic step from the back.
Male instructor demonstrates solo basic step from the back.
Instructors explain the partnering posture and connection.
Instructors demonstrate partner basic step together.
Instructors wrap up the video and give closing remarks.

safety: The woman should go on her toes to make the dance lighter.

steps_taught.name: Paso básico solo (mujer)
steps_taught.description: Solo basic footwork for the woman starting with jumps and knee lifts.

steps_taught.name: Paso básico solo (hombre)
steps_taught.description: Solo basic footwork for the man starting with backward jumps and steps.

steps_taught.name: Paso básico en pareja
steps_taught.description: Partnered basic step incorporating connection and leg push.

what_works: Clear counting and back-facing demonstration make it easy to follow along.
Breaking down solo parts before pairing up helps build confidence.
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between solo and partner demonstrations can be fast for absolute beginners.

quotes.text: La quebradita es un baile acrobático el cual lleva muchas cargadas.
Vamos a dar un salto y vamos a caer sobre la pierna derecha.
La mujer se tiene que ir a las puntas y esto lo tengo que provocar a través de mi brazo.

evidence_segments.observation: Female instructor demonstrates solo footwork facing away from the camera.
Male instructor demonstrates solo footwork facing away from the camera.
Male instructor explains the hold and posture with the female partner.

extraction.distinctive_method: Teaching solo footwork separately for men and women from behind before combining them into a partnered hold.
